note: REAL-LOG REBUILD. Charts are cut from each player’s LAST 82 GAMES (Basketball-Reference logs, regular season AND playoffs), opponent-adjusted by the opposing team's dated DEF EPM and minutes-damped to the published sizing convention (scripts/cardgen/realGames.js); the per-card provisional flag survives only where a log could not serve (carried-forward players). Shot Line, Paint Boost, 3PT Boost, Def Boost and the Speed/Power budget come from dunksandthrees' ACTUAL 2025-26 season page, regular season and playoffs pooled by volume; the 19 force-included players also fold in 2024-25. ARCHETYPE SHAPING (scripts/cardgen/archetypes.js): players below the Good-defender tier with a real offensive engine carry a def-led Speed+Power budget and an exaggerated split — their offense lives in the chart, their defense in Def Boost (round(DEF EPM), neutralize-only). See card-data/generated/card-calibration.json.
